tools.name: spur_get_property
tools.description: Show one saved Spur property as a detailed card by property_id, with owner links and enrichment status. (zpid lookups were removed; save a listing first.)

tools.name: spur_save_properties
tools.description: Save search results into the user's Spur properties (and optionally a property list). Pass listing objects from spur_search_properties structuredContent.cards[].listing. Free. Already-saved properties are updated, not duplicated.

tools.name: spur_list_saved_properties
tools.description: List properties the user has saved in Spur, optionally filtered by city, state, list, or enrichment status. Shows cards and a map.

tools.name: spur_get_property_stats
tools.description: Totals for the user's saved properties: counts by status, enrichment progress and similar portfolio-level numbers.

tools.name: spur_find_owners
tools.description: Find property owners in the user's Spur account by name, phone, email or mailing address text. Use spur_get_owner for full details and portfolio.

tools.name: spur_get_owner
tools.description: Full owner record: contact details, mailing address, enrichment status and their property portfolio in Spur.

tools.name: spur_enrich
tools.description:
Run skip tracing to find owners and their phone numbers, emails and mailing addresses.
- property_ids: find the owner of saved properties (creates/links owner records)
- owner_ids: refresh contact details for existing owners

Costs enrichment credits per record (check spur_get_billing_summary). Ask

tools.name: spur_list_property_lists
tools.description: All of the user's property lists with ids and sizes. Use the id with spur_list_saved_properties, spur_add_properties_to_list or outreach tools.

tools.name: spur_create_property_list
tools.description: Create a property list, optionally seeding it with saved property ids.

tools.name: spur_add_properties_to_list
tools.description: Add saved properties to an existing property list.

tools.name: spur_draft_message
tools.description:
Draft an email, SMS or direct-mail message with Spur's AI. Returns text only; nothing is sent. Pass owner_id/property_id to personalize with real owner and property data.

Uses 2 actions from the user's Actions pool. Use {{merge_fields}} like {{owner_first_name}} and {{property_address}} to keep it

tools.name: spur_list_workflows
tools.description: The user's multi-step outreach workflows (email/SMS/mail sequences) with status and enrollment counts.

tools.name: spur_get_workflow
tools.description: One outreach workflow's steps in order (including reply/open branches built in the app), with the email, SMS or mail template each send step uses and its step_id.

tools.name: spur_create_workflow
tools.description:
Create a multi-step outreach sequence from saved templates. It's saved as an inactive draft: nothing sends until it's activated (spur_set_workflow_active) and owners are enrolled.

Send steps take a saved template: email/SMS from spur_list_message_templates (design new ones with spur_create_email_te

tools.name: spur_set_workflow_step_template
tools.description: Set which saved template a workflow's send step uses (send_email ← email template, send_sms ← SMS template, send_direct_mail ← postcard/letter template). Get step_ids from spur_get_workflow. If the workflow is active, enrolled owners get the new template from their next send.

tools.name: spur_set_workflow_active
tools.description: Activate a workflow (enrolled owners start receiving its emails, texts and mail on schedule, which uses credits) or pause it. Activating requires every send step to have a template and the user's explicit approval.

tools.name: spur_enroll_owners_in_workflow
tools.description: Enroll owners in an outreach workflow. The workflow will start emailing/texting/mailing them on its schedule, which uses credits. Confirm the workflow name and owner count with the user first.

tools.name: spur_send_sms
tools.description: Text an owner from the user's default approved number (or Spur's workspace number if they have none; see spur_get_texting_setup). Show the user the exact message and recipient and get approval before calling with confirm=true. Billed per 160-character segment (70 if it has emoji or special character

tools.name: spur_list_sms_conversations
tools.description: SMS conversations with owners, newest first, with unread counts and the last message. Good for triaging replies (hot leads, not interested, wrong number).

tools.name: spur_get_sms_conversation
tools.description: The full SMS thread with one owner, oldest first.

tools.name: spur_get_outreach_report
tools.description: Outreach performance (sent, delivered, opened, replied, by channel) for all workflows or one, over an optional date range.

tools.name: spur_edit_workflow
tools.description: Insert/update steps, change waits and branches, remove named steps, reorder, or rename a workflow. Unmentioned steps are retained. New IDs must start step_. Branch parent IDs must exist. Editing a live workflow requires confirmation. Activation is a separate tool.

tools.name: spur_manage_workflow
tools.description: Read enrollments, execution logs or stats; duplicate as a draft; delete; unenroll one contact; retry failed enrollments. Retrying can resume real sends and requires approval.

tools.name: spur_get_outreach_message
tools.description: Read a sent message's body, delivery details and response context.

tools.name: spur_list_message_templates
tools.description: The user's saved email and SMS templates. These are what outreach workflow send_email / send_sms steps use.

tools.name: spur_get_message_template
tools.description: Fetch an email template's subject, HTML and plain text, or an SMS template's text, for reading or editing. For small changes prefer the update tool's replacements over resending everything.

tools.name: spur_preview_message_template
tools.description: Show a saved email (inbox view, desktop and mobile) or SMS (phone view, segment count) rendered with sample data or a real owner's data, plus design checks. Changes nothing.

tools.name: spur_preview_message_draft
tools.description:
Preview email HTML or SMS text before saving it: renders it with sample or real owner data and runs the design checks. Nothing is saved; iterate here, then save with spur_create_email_template / spur_create_sms_template.

Email HTML guidance (see spur://email-design-guide): full HTML document, table

tools.name: spur_create_email_template
tools.description:
Save a new email template and show its inbox preview. Ways to start:
- From blank: start_from_blank=true gives a tested 600px responsive layout with greeting, signature and a compliant footer; pass html to replace it.
- Redesign: base_template_id copies one of the user's email templates.
- From scra

tools.name: spur_update_email_template
tools.description: Edit one of the user's email templates and show the updated inbox preview. For tweaks pass replacements (exact find → replace in "html", "subject" or "text"); to redesign pass full html. When the HTML changes, the plain-text version is regenerated unless it was hand-written or you pass text_body. Wo

tools.name: spur_create_sms_template
tools.description:
Save a new SMS template and show its phone preview with segment count and checks. The saved template can then be used by outreach workflows (spur_create_workflow / spur_set_workflow_step_template).

SMS guidance: plain text, ideally one segment (160 GSM characters, or 70 if it uses emoji or other no

tools.name: spur_update_sms_template
tools.description:
Edit one of the user's SMS templates and show the updated preview. Pass full text / fallback_body, or replacements (exact find → replace in "text" or "fallback"). Pass fallback_body="" to remove the fallback.

SMS guidance: plain text, ideally one segment (160 GSM characters, or 70 if it uses emoji

tools.name: spur_delete_message_template
tools.description: Delete one of the user's email or SMS templates. Workflow steps that use it will fail until they get another template, so check spur_list_workflows and confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_send_test_email
tools.description: Send an email template, filled with sample data (or one owner's data), to the user's own Spur account email from their email sender, to check it in a real inbox. Never goes to owners. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_list_postcard_templates
tools.description: Postcard templates available to the user: their own (editable), Spur defaults, and Spur's built-in gallery. Copy a default or gallery design with spur_create_postcard_template base_template_id to redesign it, or start from blank with start_from_blank.

tools.name: spur_get_postcard_template
tools.description: Fetch a postcard template's HTML for reading or editing. For small text changes prefer spur_update_postcard_template with replacements instead of resending whole HTML.

tools.name: spur_preview_postcard_template
tools.description: Show any postcard template (yours, a Spur default or a gallery design) rendered with sample data, without changing anything.

tools.name: spur_create_postcard_template
tools.description:
Create a postcard template and show a preview. Three ways to start:
- From blank: start_from_blank=true gives an empty, correctly sized canvas for the size (any side you pass HTML for replaces the blank side).
- Redesign an existing template: base_template_id (yours, a Spur default or a gallery id)

tools.name: spur_update_postcard_template
tools.description: Edit one of the user's postcard templates and show the updated preview. For text tweaks pass replacements (exact find → replace on a side); to redesign, pass full front_html/back_html. Spur default and gallery templates can't be edited: copy them first with spur_create_postcard_template base_templat

tools.name: spur_add_postcard_qr_code
tools.description:
Put a tracked QR code on the back of one of the user's postcard templates and show the preview. Each mailed postcard gets its own code under the chosen QR code, so scans are tracked per recipient (spur_get_qr_code_activity).

Placement: position="auto" fills the back's QR slot (an element with class

tools.name: spur_remove_postcard_qr_code
tools.description: Remove the tracked QR code from one of the user's postcard templates (both sides) and show the preview. A QR slot from the design stays, empty.

tools.name: spur_delete_postcard_template
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the user's postcard templates. Spur defaults can't be deleted. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_list_return_addresses
tools.description: Return addresses saved for direct mail. The default one is used when a campaign doesn't specify one.

tools.name: spur_preview_postcard_campaign
tools.description:
Required step before mailing postcards. Renders the postcard with the first recipient's real data, checks which owners have mailing addresses, estimates the cost from the user's plan, and returns a confirmation_token.

Show the preview, then ask the user to approve. Only after they approve, call spu

tools.name: spur_send_postcards
tools.description: Mail the postcards approved in spur_preview_postcard_campaign. Irreversible and charges the user's account. Requires the preview's confirmation_token and the user's explicit approval (confirm=true).

tools.name: spur_list_qr_codes
tools.description: The user's tracked QR codes: destination URL, colors, and which of their postcard templates print each one. Put one on a postcard with spur_add_postcard_qr_code; see scans with spur_get_qr_code_activity.

tools.name: spur_create_qr_code
tools.description: Create a tracked QR code that sends scans to destination_url. Then add it to a postcard back with spur_add_postcard_qr_code; each mailed postcard gets its own code under it so scans are tracked per recipient.

tools.name: spur_update_qr_code
tools.description: Rename a QR code, change where scans go, or change its colors. A new destination also applies to postcards already mailed with this code. Templates pick up new colors at send time.

tools.name: spur_delete_qr_code
tools.description: Permanently delete a QR code. Refused while one of the user's postcard templates still prints it: remove it from those first with spur_remove_postcard_qr_code. Postcards already mailed keep redirecting. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_get_qr_code_activity
tools.description: Scan activity for a QR code: totals, which mailed recipients (owners) scanned their postcard, and recent scans of the code itself. Use it to find warm leads from a postcard campaign.

tools.name: spur_list_images
tools.description: The user's saved images (logos, headshots, property photos) with their public URLs, newest first. Use it as (or a CSS background-image) in postcard, letter or email HTML. To add one, use spur_upload_image (from the user's device) or spur_save_image (from a URL).

tools.name: spur_save_image
tools.description: Download an image from a public https URL (the user's website, a shared photo link) and save it to the user's Spur image library, so it stays available for printing and sending. Returns the saved image's URL. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to 20 MB. For a file on the user's device, use spur_upload_i

tools.name: spur_upload_image
tools.description: Show an upload box where the user picks or drops an image from their device (logo, headshot, property photo); it's saved to their Spur image library. Use this whenever the user wants to use their own image, including one they attached to the chat: attachments don't reach Spur, so ask them to drop it

tools.name: spur_save_uploaded_image
tools.description: Used by the upload widget to save the file the user picked. Not for the assistant.

tools.name: spur_delete_image
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the user's saved images. Refused while one of their postcard, letter or email templates still uses it, since those would show a broken image. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_list_letter_templates
tools.description: Letter templates available to the user, with their letter type (Top First Page or Insert Blank Page): their own (editable), Spur defaults, and Spur's built-in gallery. Copy one with spur_create_letter_template base_template_id to redesign it, or start from blank with start_from_blank.

tools.name: spur_get_letter_template
tools.description: Fetch a letter template's HTML for reading or editing. For small text changes prefer spur_update_letter_template with replacements instead of resending the whole HTML.

tools.name: spur_preview_letter_template
tools.description: Show any letter template (yours, a Spur default or a gallery design) rendered with sample data, without changing anything.

tools.name: spur_create_letter_template
tools.description:
Create a letter template and show a preview. Pick the letter type first (top_first_page or insert_blank_page); it decides where the address prints and how much of the page the design can use. Three ways to start:
- From blank: start_from_blank=true gives an empty one-page letter laid out for the let

tools.name: spur_update_letter_template
tools.description: Edit one of the user's letter templates and show the updated preview. For text tweaks pass replacements (exact find → replace); to redesign, pass full html. letter_type switches between top_first_page and insert_blank_page. Spur default and gallery templates can't be edited: copy them first with spu

tools.name: spur_delete_letter_template
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the user's letter templates. Spur defaults can't be deleted. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_preview_letter_campaign
tools.description: Required step before mailing letters. Renders the letter with the first recipient's real data in its letter type's layout, checks which owners have mailing addresses, estimates the cost from the user's plan (Insert Blank Page letters include the extra address page), and returns a confirmation_token.

tools.name: spur_send_letters
tools.description: Mail the letters approved in spur_preview_letter_campaign. Irreversible and charges the user's account. Requires the preview's confirmation_token and the user's explicit approval (confirm=true).

tools.name: spur_get_billing_summary
tools.description: Plan, wallet balance, and this period's usage and remaining allowance per feature (searches, enrichment, SMS, postcards, letters, AI). Check this before large sends.

tools.name: spur_list_campaigns
tools.description: The user's campaigns (bulk email, SMS, direct mail, outreach) with status and recipient progress.

tools.name: spur_get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Delivery and run statistics for one campaign.

tools.name: spur_get_direct_mail_analytics
tools.description: Letters and postcards sent, delivered, in transit and returned, plus USPS tracking totals and spend.

tools.name: spur_show_billing_options
tools.description: Shows the user's wallet balance, one-click top-up amounts, auto-recharge status and every Spur plan with prices, in a widget with Pay/Upgrade buttons. Use whenever the user wants to add funds, buy credits, upgrade, change or compare plans, or a send failed for billing reasons.

tools.name: spur_top_up_wallet
tools.description: Creates a Stripe checkout link to add funds to the user's Spur wallet (pays for postcards, letters, SMS, data credit and action top-ups, and other usage beyond the plan). No money moves until the user pays on Stripe, so no confirmation is needed. If the user didn't name an amount, suggest $25, $50 o

tools.name: spur_change_plan
tools.description:
Moves the user to another Spur plan (ids from spur_show_billing_options; usually team or brokerage).
- No paid subscription yet: returns a Stripe checkout link. No confirmation needed.
- Already subscribed: switches the plan immediately and charges or credits the prorated difference to the saved car

tools.name: spur_buy_credit_pack
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout link for metric packs at the account's current price. Adds dollars to the shared wallet; it does not increase monthly allowances or reserve units. Free accounts must upgrade. No charge occurs until the user pays on Stripe.

tools.name: spur_get_usage_analytics
tools.description: Read dated usage, spend and wallet activity. Free.

tools.name: spur_check_payment
tools.description: After the user pays a Stripe checkout link from spur_top_up_wallet or spur_change_plan, confirms the payment went through and returns the new wallet balance and plan. Safe to call repeatedly.

tools.name: spur_manage_billing
tools.description: Link to the user's Stripe billing portal: update the card on file, download invoices, change or cancel the subscription.

tools.name: spur_set_auto_recharge
tools.description: Turns wallet auto-recharge on or off. When on, Spur charges the saved card amount_usd whenever the balance drops below threshold_usd, so sends never fail for lack of funds. Needs a saved card (the first spur_top_up_wallet payment saves one). Turning it on needs the user's approval of the amount and

tools.name: spur_list_search_automations
tools.description: Scheduled property searches with their schedule, filters, and next/last run times.

tools.name: spur_create_search_automation
tools.description: Schedule a recurring property search. Event automations default to the legacy engine to retain event tracking. Data-platform mode supports recipe_key/params/selections, credit budgets, unknown-result lists, automatic contacts with a credit cap and conditions, and channel outreach routes. Each enable

tools.name: spur_run_search_automation
tools.description: Run an approved search automation now. Can spend credits/actions and enroll owners in outreach according to its settings. Inspect it with spur_manage_search_automation get first; confirm the exact run.

tools.name: spur_get_automation_logs
tools.description: Recent runs of a search automation: when, how many found/saved/enriched, and errors.

tools.name: spur_manage_search_automation
tools.description: Get full settings, update/enable/disable, delete, or preview/apply migration to Data Search. Updating an enabled automation or applying migration needs approval because subsequent runs can spend/contact people. Disable is immediate.

tools.name: spur_get_texting_setup
tools.description: The user's texting setup: phone numbers bought in Spur (and which can send), carrier (A2P 10DLC) registration status, carrier notes, what's still missing, and the next step. Call this before helping with numbers or registration.

tools.name: spur_search_phone_numbers
tools.description: Search local US numbers the user can buy, by area code, state, city or digits. Show the options and let the user pick before spur_buy_phone_number. Prefer an area code in the user's market.

tools.name: spur_buy_phone_number
tools.description: Buy a local number for the user's account (it's theirs immediately and replies land in their SMS inbox). It can't send texts until their carrier registration is approved. Plans include some numbers; beyond that each costs $5/mo from the Spur wallet, first month charged now (spur_get_texting_setup sh

tools.name: spur_set_default_phone_number
tools.description: Make one of the user's bought numbers the default sender for their texts.

tools.name: spur_release_phone_number
tools.description: Permanently give up one of the user's bought numbers. They may never get it back, and contacts texting it will no longer reach them. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: spur_save_texting_registration
tools.description: Create or update the user's carrier (A2P 10DLC) registration draft. Pass only the fields to change; nested objects merge. Pick registration_type from two questions: has an EIN? (no → sole_proprietor) and more than ~2,000 texts/day? (yes → standard, else low_volume_standard). Business details must ma

tools.name: spur_submit_texting_registration
tools.description: Send the user's registration to the carriers (also resubmits a rejected one after fixes). Charges the Spur wallet: $29 one-time for low volume / sole proprietor or $79 for standard (includes the first month, then $3 or $15/mo), or $15 to resubmit after a carrier rejection; spur_get_texting_setup sho

tools.name: spur_pay_texting_fees
tools.description: Retry overdue monthly number and registration fees from the Spur wallet right away (normally retried daily). Use after the user adds funds. Restores paused numbers once paid. Charges the wallet: confirm the amount with the user first.

tools.name: spur_resend_texting_verification
tools.description: Sole proprietors only: re-send the carrier's verification text (the user replies YES) when the previous one expired after 24 hours.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the user's saved Spur properties, owners, lists, workflows, research jobs/tables and templates by keyword (address, city, owner name, phone, email, template name). Returns ids for the fetch tool. For new properties use spur_data_search.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a record returned by search, including list, workflow, table, job, letter, message_template or personalization IDs.

tools.name: spur_list_data_providers
tools.description: List the property and contact data providers connected to Spur, what each can supply, its status, and known limitations. Free. Use the names here when telling the user where data comes from.

tools.name: spur_get_property_sources
tools.description:
Read a saved property's data with the source beside every value: which provider supplied it, when, how it was selected, whether it is a fallback or a calculation, and which fields are still unknown. Free, makes no paid lookups.

Always tell the user the source of any number you repeat (e.g. "Estimat

tools.name: spur_get_field_sources
tools.description: Show every stored value for one field of a saved property, with its provider and date, plus which other providers could supply it and how many data credits a lookup uses. Free. Use this to answer "where did this number come from?" or before switching provider.

tools.name: spur_plan_property_data
tools.description: Show which providers Spur would use to fill the requested fields of a saved property, which stored values would be reused for free, and what it would cost. Makes no paid call. Always run this and show the user the result before spur_refresh_property_data.

tools.name: spur_refresh_property_data
tools.description: Run the lookup previewed by spur_plan_property_data and return the updated values with their sources. Can spend the user's credits and provider costs. Requires the user's explicit approval of the preview (confirm=true). A provider with no record is never charged and never silently replaced by anothe

tools.name: spur_parse_data_search
tools.description: Turn a plain-English request into a Data Search (filters, recipe, and provider choice) without searching or charging. Recipe requests can run directly with spur_run_data_job; other searches require confirmation before spur_data_search. Providers are only fixed when the user named one.

tools.name: spur_data_search
tools.description:
Search properties across Spur's data providers in one search. Set listing_status to search current listings (ZHomes); leave it out to search off-market and owner records, routed automatically to the best source (county records, distress data) or to the provider the user named.

Each value is labeled

tools.name: spur_save_data_results
tools.description: Save Data Search results (from spur_data_search) or a job's matched items (from spur_run_data_job) as the user's properties, with owners that outreach can use. Free: the search already paid for the data. Unknown job items can go to a separate list for review.

tools.name: spur_run_data_job
tools.description:
Start a recipe job immediately. Every enabled step runs automatically, including owner contact enrichment and Do Not Call checks by default; set includeContacts=false to skip contacts. Recipes (key: params besides location, maxCandidates, unknownPolicy, includeContacts):
- motivated_seller: off-mark

tools.name: spur_get_data_job
tools.description: Status, counts, and results of a Data Search job. Results are available while the job runs. Each value names its provider. Free.

tools.name: spur_get_data_catalog
tools.description: Read the full field catalog, live recipes and credit sheets, industry waterfall, or dated data usage. Free.

tools.name: spur_manage_data_preferences
tools.description: Get, save, or delete persistent source preferences. Saving preferences makes no paid lookup. Read the segment/catalog first.

tools.name: spur_select_property_field
tools.description: Choose a stored observation, lock a field to a provider, restore Automatic, or choose/clear a primary contact item. Paid provider selection requires confirm=true; inspect sources and the lookup plan first.

tools.name: spur_get_property_dnc
tools.description: Stored per-number DNC result, blocked state, provider, check date and expiry. Free; requires the account's restricted-contact permission. A clear DNC check does not establish consent to text.

tools.name: spur_plan_property_dnc
tools.description: Quote checks for unchecked or expired numbers. Free. Show the credits before calling spur_check_property_dnc.

tools.name: spur_check_property_dnc
tools.description: Run approved DNC checks with the quoted credit ceiling. Retains suppression and partial results if a provider fails. Requires approval of the quote.

tools.name: spur_estimate_data_job
tools.description: Get the credit estimate without creating, running, saving, or charging a recipe job. Execution is a separate call to spur_run_data_job and starts immediately.

tools.name: spur_list_data_jobs
tools.description: Recover job IDs, statuses and budgets, including jobs started in the app. Free.

tools.name: spur_control_data_job
tools.description: Pause/cancel a job, or resume it with an optional revised budget. Resume can spend credits and requires confirm=true. Preserves completed results.

tools.name: spur_list_search_tables
tools.description: Reopen saved search tables from the app or MCP. Free.

tools.name: spur_manage_search_table
tools.description: Reopen, delete, record signed search results into a table, or save selected rows to properties/a list for free. Create tables with spur_data_search keep_table=true. Deleting a table does not delete saved properties.

tools.name: spur_estimate_table_column
tools.description: Estimate a contacts column for selected/all loaded rows, with optional conditions and provider order. Free; skipped rows and maximum credits are returned.

tools.name: spur_run_table_column
tools.description: Start the approved contacts column as a background run under a credit ceiling. Saves rows for free, then enriches; poll with spur_control_table_run action=get.

tools.name: spur_control_table_run
tools.description: Get progress/changed rows, resume under a credit ceiling, or cancel. Resume requires approval and is safe to retry without double charging.

tools.name: spur_route_table_outreach
tools.description: Enroll each selected owner in the first reachable configured channel in order. Skips duplicate enrollments. This can start real outreach; approve the workflows and audience first.

tools.name: spur_get_personalization
tools.description: Read the live angle/goal/tone/token catalog, current settings, a list's review queue, a saved line, or angle performance. Free. New merge fields include ai_opener, ai_reason, ai_cta, ai_ps, ai_subject, ai_first_name and ai_custom_<slug>.

tools.name: spur_update_personalization_settings
tools.description: Set voice, goal, approved angles, fallbacks, custom AI fields and human review. Read the catalog first. Enabling auto_generate can spend Actions on subsequent list additions; confirm the settings with the user.

tools.name: spur_generate_personalization
tools.description: Try settings on one property, generate a list preview (up to 10 records), generate all selected list records, or regenerate one saved line. Generation can spend Actions even in preview mode. Requires approval. Never sends outreach; review/edit/approve the stored lines separately.

tools.name: spur_review_personalization
tools.description: Edit per-channel copy/custom fields or approve saved records after reviewing them. Reviewed lines are preserved by generation. Does not send outreach.

tools.name: spur_manage_property_list
tools.description: Read a list and its stats, rename it, delete it, remove members, or copy/move members to another list. Moves add to the destination before removing from the source; a partial failure reports progress. Does not send outreach.

tools.name: spur_connect_list_automation
tools.description: Link/unlink a workflow, enroll a whole list, attach/detach a search automation. Linking a workflow immediately enrolls current members. Approve the audience, workflow and future automatic outreach before connecting.

tools.name: spur_add_manual_properties
tools.description: Preview a typed address for free, create a property with manually supplied facts/contacts, or import up to 100 mapped rows from CSV. No provider lookup. CSV rows use the documented address/details/owner shape; do not invent missing data.

tools.name: spur_update_property
tools.description: Edit saved property fields, correct manually entered owner contacts, or soft-delete a property. Manual corrections are user-supplied facts and make no paid lookup.

tools.name: spur_manage_owner
tools.description: Create/edit an owner, correct manual contacts, link a saved property, soft-delete, or preview enrichment without running it. Owner/property ownership is checked before linking.

tools.name: spur_manage_trash
tools.description: List deleted records or restore a property, owner, or list. Permanent deletion and empty-trash require explicit confirmation.

tools.name: spur_get_property_events
tools.description: Read an individual property's event history, recent portfolio events, or the event-type catalog. Free. Event dates and detection dates are distinct.

tools.name: spur_refresh_property_events
tools.description: Fetch current listing/record events. Can spend data credits; approve the selected sources first.

tools.name: spur_get_email_setup
tools.description: Read sender identities, domain DNS/verification instructions, rotation settings, email analytics or sender stats. Free.

tools.name: spur_manage_email_sender
tools.description: Create/update/delete senders, set a default, verify a sender domain, or update rotation settings. Changes affect subsequent sends. Domain credentials stay in the Spur app; no API keys or SMTP passwords are accepted here.

tools.name: spur_manage_email_domain
tools.description: Create/update a sending domain and return DNS instructions, verify DNS records, or delete a custom domain. No email is sent. If credentials are required, complete that step in Spur settings.

tools.name: spur_send_bulk_email
tools.description: Queue the exact approved subject/content and recipient set. Show the email preview (spur_preview_message_draft) and audience before approval. Recipients can be mapped CSV rows. Charges email usage; never automatically retry a timed-out send.

tools.name: spur_send_bulk_sms
tools.description: Queue the exact approved message and recipient set, including mapped CSV rows. Show the text, audience and segment cost first. Requires recipient consent; a clear DNC result does not establish opt-in. Never automatically retry a timed-out send.

tools.name: spur_manage_sms_inbox
tools.description: Read the unread count, page inbound replies, or mark specific messages read after triage.

tools.name: spur_manage_texting_registration
tools.description: Refresh registration status from the carrier, or discard a draft registration after confirmation. Existing save/submit/pay/resend tools cover the rest of setup.

tools.name: spur_manage_return_address
tools.description: Create/edit/delete a return address, or verify a recipient address. Creation and address edits use Spur's provider verification. Review verification feedback before sending mail.

tools.name: spur_get_mail_tracking
tools.description: List orders or mailpieces, inspect one order/piece, or read a piece's tracking events. Returns pagination metadata for list views.

tools.name: spur_control_mail_order
tools.description: Cancel an eligible order with its provider or request fresh tracking for one mailpiece. Cancellation availability is decided by Spur and the provider; never claim a delivered piece can be recalled.

tools.name: spur_get_qr_manager
tools.description: Read standalone redirects, recipients, manager activity, scan events, or dated analytics, including codes not attached to postcards. List results retain server pagination.

tools.name: spur_manage_qr_redirect
tools.description: Create or edit a standalone redirect, or delete it and its recipient codes. Edits affect already printed codes. Postcard-linked parent codes should use spur_update_qr_code to keep their linked redirect synchronized.

tools.name: spur_manage_qr_recipients
tools.description: Create one or up to 500 recipient codes under a redirect, update a code, or delete it. No outreach is sent. Edits/deletion affect printed codes.

tools.name: spur_get_workspace
tools.description: Read your profile/business identity, onboarding checklist, available outreach strategies, or monday.com connection and list-sync status. Never returns another user's account.

tools.name: spur_update_workspace
tools.description: Edit your business identity, email preferences, market/outreach intent, or dismiss/restore the checklist. Identity is used by template merge fields. Does not change credentials or account permissions.

tools.name: spur_manage_monday_sync
tools.description: Get a secure OAuth handoff link, disconnect, enable list-to-board sync, run sync now, or disable it. Sync writes prospect data to monday.com; approve the exact list/board first. No tokens or credentials are accepted in chat.

tools.name: spur_manage_campaign
tools.description: Create/update/delete a campaign draft, inspect a campaign/runs, stage consenting recipients respecting opt-outs, cancel, or retry failed runs. Launch requires a separate preview token. Retrying can send and needs approval.

tools.name: spur_preview_campaign
tools.description: Review current configuration, channel content, recipient count and billing. Mail-containing sequences show sample postcard artwork and clear zones. Returns a 30-minute token bound to the campaign, channel templates and mail return address. Nothing launches.

tools.name: spur_launch_campaign
tools.description: Launch the exact sequence reviewed by spur_preview_campaign. Refuses expired tokens or changed configuration, template content or audience counts. Can send and spend credits; do not automatically retry a timed-out launch.

tools.name: spur_manage_mail_campaign
tools.description: Manage campaign-specific templates, stage owner recipients, inspect jobs and summary. Staging verifies addresses and can spend personalization Actions; requires approval. Dispatch uses a separate mail preview and token. These templates are distinct from normal direct-mail templates.

tools.name: spur_preview_mail_campaign
tools.description: Show staged postcard artwork, recipient count, return address, cost and USPS clear zones. Returns a token tied to all sendable jobs, template and return address. Nothing dispatches until approval.

tools.name: spur_dispatch_mail_campaign
tools.description: Dispatch exactly the staged campaign reviewed by spur_preview_mail_campaign. Rejects changed jobs/artwork/address and expired or cross-purpose tokens. Confirm only after the user approves the artwork and cost.

tools.name: spur_export_contacts
tools.description: Export selected saved properties or one list as CSV. DNC/TCPA-blocked, invalid and disallowed numbers never enter callable Phone columns. Blocked numbers are labeled separately; spreadsheet formulas are escaped. Returns an inline text/csv resource, with pagination for large lists. Makes no provider
